mechanism.description: Chainlink Data Feeds (NAVLink, Proof of Reserve): an EACAggregatorProxy in front of one OCR aggregator per phase. A round is written by an OCR transmit of the network's transmitter set (a quorum of node operators signing the issuer's or auditor's figure), never by an issuer key; the aggregator clamps nothing but rejects a median outside minAnswer..maxAnswer, so an answer exactly on either bound is the range limit, not the market (class D, aggregated). Rounds are read from AnswerUpdated on every phase aggregator with the transmitter taken from NewTransmission of the same transaction (the OCR2 and the OCR1 layout both carry it in the second data word); the feed directory's heartbeat (plus one hour of grace) bounds the silence between rounds and its deviation threshold classifies the moves. Left out on purpose: M NAV (0xC28198Df, M^0), a high-frequency feed with over 76,000 rounds whose aggregator emits NewRound without a transmitter. The proxies' AggregatorConfirmed events are swept as notices; none was found on these proxies through the explorer, so the phase history is the log_addresses list read from phaseAggregators().

source.note: heartbeat and threshold per feed from https://reference-data-directory.vercel.app/feeds-mainnet.json (raw/chainlink-feeds-mainnet-json-2026-09-01.md); phase aggregators read through phaseId() and phaseAggregators(i) on 2026-09-02; no aggregator source was verified by this adapter

notice_events.note: the proxy switched to a new aggregator (a phase change); rounds continue on the new contract
